India march into the semi-finals!
The Indian men's hockey team put on a stellar performance, securing a dominant 4-1 victory over Japan to seal their spot in the semi-finals!
Abhishek led the charge with a brilliant brace, while Harmanpreet Singh and Vishnukant Singh added a goal each to complete a convincing win for Team India!
